column13: A Succint one line game comment to summarise that game
North Melbourne roared back from 27 points down at three-quarter time to tie Collingwood in a breathtaking draw.
North Melbourne dominated the replay, with Arnold Briedis kicking five goals in a 27-point victory over Collingwood.
